decisions.question: Upstream flips the OD Next strategy route default from opt-in to default-on (unconfigured installs resolve `active` instead of `off`). Port to the fork? si/no
decisions.context: Fork has the full rollout machinery + LabsSection opt-out switch, so the port is feasible. It is a deliberate product-policy inversion, not a defect fix — flipping changes behavior for every unconfigured install.
options: si: port the full #7876 changeset (rollout.ts default + contracts comments + LabsSection copy + tests)
no: keep opt-in default `off`; record as deliberate fork divergence
decisions.resolution: Implemented: upstream bb9682a5f ported as afa6500d2. Default resolves to active; explicit off and unreadable-config-to-off invariants hold; Labs switch is the opt-out.

decisions.question: El gateway solo expone /healthz. ¿Añadir observabilidad propia? si/no + opción
decisions.context: auth_audit ya captura logins; hay rate-limit buckets en memoria. Sin métricas no hay visibilidad de abuso ni salud más allá del binario healthz.
options: metrics: endpoint /metrics estilo Prometheus (login_success/failure, rate-limit hits, sesiones activas) leyendo auth_audit + buckets
logs: solo logs estructurados JSON con request-id
decisions.resolution: Implemented: GET /metrics serves Prometheus text gated by metricsToken in the protected gateway JSON (unset -> 404). Bounded-cardinality gauges with no PII: uptime, active sessions, auth_events{event,detail} over the retained auth_audit window. Commit 46c7fdff9, 46/46 tests.

decisions.question: proxyAmrApiRequest conserva 6 tokens de error planos porque el binario vela (ELF compilado) es el consumidor y su parsing de errores no es verificable desde fuente. ¿Cómo proceder?
decisions.context: Es la última superficie sin envelope {error:{code,message}} en el daemon. Convertir sin verificar el parser del binario vela puede romper el login AMR.
options: acceso: proporcionar contrato/fuente de errores del binario vela para verificar parsing, luego envelopar
si: envelopar igualmente y validar contra el binario en staging
no: declarar excepción documentada permanente (superficie externa del binario)
decisions.resolution: Recorded as permanent documented exception: the vela binary consumes flat error tokens and its parse contract is not verifiable from the fork. Converting blind would break the binary error path. SAAS_GAPS D3 closed with this exception noted.

decisions.question: El gateway no tiene mailer (sin reset-password, welcome, alertas). ¿Añadir emails transaccionales? si/no
decisions.needs: si/no + si sí: secreto (credenciales SMTP via ACV2 intake) + valor (sender address) + opción de proveedor
options: si: indicar proveedor (SES / SendGrid / SMTP corporativo) y remitente; credenciales por ACV2 secret intake
no: comunicación fuera de banda (Discord/ops) como hoy
decisions.resolution: Not implemented: no SMTP decision or credential exists, and internal-user communication happens out of band. Adding a mailer would require a secrets intake plus product decision.

decisions.question: Falta un destino real de help/docs/contacto para enlazar in-app. ¿Cuál es el destino de soporte?
options: url: portal/docs existente (ej. página de soporte interna)
ninguno: omitir superficie de ayuda in-app
decisions.resolution: Verified: no real support/help/contact URL or email exists anywhere in the fork to link to. Decision recorded as "none" rather than inventing a dead link.

decisions.question: El fork no tiene planes ni cuotas. ¿Se prevé metering/limits por org? si/no
options: si: definir dimensión (runs/mes, usuarios/org, AMR spend) — requiere diseño previo
no: sin límites; capacidad gestionada por infraestructura
decisions.resolution: Not implemented: no plans or quotas exist in the fork and the user population is internal. Metering without a pricing model is dead machinery.

decisions.question: Existe GruiaExamples como primer valor. ¿Construir checklist post-signup en la web? si/no
decisions.context: Coste alto (web divergida), retorno bajo para ~usuarios internos.
decisions.resolution: Not implemented: GruiaExamples gallery already delivers first value; a post-signup checklist is product work on the diverged web with high cost and low return for internal users.

decisions.question: Acceso por org concedido externamente; no hay flujo de invitación. ¿Construir invite flow? si/no
options: si: requiere diseño (org admin invita por email — depende de transactional-emails)
no: admisión externa permanece; cerrar gap
decisions.resolution: Not implemented: org admission is granted externally; there is no invite surface in the fork. Depends on transactional-emails (also no).
